scripts.dev: npm --prefix web exec concurrently -n web,backend -c green,blue "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project web/backend python web/backend/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && uv run --project web/backend ruff check --cache-dir web/backend/.ruff_cache web/backend
